name: v0 / rtl/v0.v (opt)
headline: minimum 1 modelled flip(s) -> 1 injection event(s) assumed -> PSA rating 20 (<= L3 ceiling 20, in scope at L3: the device must resist it); JIL re-scored 16 ('Basic')
events_reasoning: flips_per_event = any (default for fault_type=voltage): one injection event is assumed able to cause every flip of the attack in its clock cycle, so 1 flip(s) count as 1 event

sensitivity.assumption: one glitch can cause every flip of a cycle (flips_per_event=any)
every flip needs its own injection (flips_per_event=1)

disclaimer: Estimate only. It supports, and never replaces, evaluation by an accredited lab: the scores use the schemes' point tables, but the factor levels are assumptions about a modelled result, not a lab rating of a demonstrated attack.

timing.source: source: 2 witness(es) of the bounded runs, not a complete listing
timing.text: every listed minimum attack puts all its flips in ONE clock cycle (source: 2 witness(es) of the bounded runs, not a complete listing): a single, well-timed injection event could in principle cause it, if one event can flip all of those nets
notes: For fault analysis, a lack of accuracy in the synchronisation requirements 'can render the analysis to recover the key much more complex'; no point value is attached to timing precision.

Several perturbations may be required (one per firewall check); performing them is 'difficult, however still feasible' because the check can be found by synchronisation. No point value is given for this.
